prompt:
Produce a concise advisory implementation PLAN ONLY for the following EmpireOS task. Do not edit files, emit deployment commands, perform production actions, contact external parties, mutate databases, move funds, or expand authority. Identify affected modules, focused tests, main risks, dependencies, and approval gates.

TASK:
Build the EmpireOS Founder Cockpit voice-control layer: JARVIS-style but Empire-native. Use the existing Founder Dashboard, execution plane, agent routing, revenue command queue, Whisper/sherpa/TTS/voice stack. Typed and spoken commands must share one governed intent contract with READ, SAFE_INTERNAL_WRITE, and FOUNDER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED classes. Build cockpit navigation for Overview, Enterprise Pipeline, Acquisition, Revenue, Products, Intelligence, and System Health. Add real quality metrics and analytics, not vanity metrics. Example command: 'Denver needs 20 roofing leads now, send them to X company' must resolve buyer, verify capacity/terms/compliance, select qualified owned inventory, prepare allocation, stop at founder approval before external delivery, then verify/record. Never grant autonomous outbound, payment, destructive infrastructure, binding terms, or authority expansion. Architecture-first, focused tests, independent verification. Do not deploy production without founder approval.
